result.description:
OFFICE MANAGER
Crossbay Pty Ltd T/A Drive Ready Australia
Location: Welshpool, Western Australia 
Employment Type: Full-time 
Salary: $79,423 plus Superannuation 
About Us
Drive Ready Australia is a growing vehicle rental and automotive services company based in Perth. We manage a fleet of more than 200 vehicles and are committed to delivering reliable rental solutions and outstanding customer service. We are seeking an experienced and organised Office Manager to oversee our administrative operations and support the continued growth of our business.
Key Responsibilities
The successful applicant will be responsible for:
•	Managing the day-to-day administrative and operational activities of the business. 
•	Coordinating communication between customers, workshop staff, suppliers and management. 
•	Managing financial administration, including rental payments, driver payments, bank reconciliations, outstanding accounts, payment plans and daily financial reporting. 
•	Administering end-to-end motor vehicle insurance claims, including preparing documentation, liaising with insurers and monitoring claims until completion. 
•	Coordinating fleet administration for more than 200 vehicles, including maintenance scheduling, repairs, onboarding and offboarding, GPS installations and vehicle availability. 
•	Preparing repair quotations, sourcing vehicle parts, liaising with suppliers and panel beaters, and supporting workshop operations. 
•	Preparing operational, financial, fleet and insurance reports for management. 
•	Supervising office administration, allocating tasks, assisting with staff onboarding and providing administrative support to employees. 
•	Preparing rental agreements, maintaining electronic records and ensuring accurate business documentation. 
•	Building strong relationships with customers, suppliers, insurers and business partners while resolving enquiries professionally. 
•	Identifying opportunities to improve office procedures and administrative efficiency. 
Essential Requirements
Applicants should possess:
•	At least an AQF Diploma or higher qualification in Business, Management, Administration or a related field; or at least three years of relevant full-time work experience. 
•	Demonstrated experience in office management or business administration. 
•	Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. 
•	Experience in financial administration, including reconciliations and reporting. 
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
•	High level of computer literacy, including Microsoft Office and business management software. 
•	Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
•	Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 
Desirable
•	Experience in the motor vehicle, transport, fleet management or automotive industry. 
•	Experience dealing with insurance claims and vehicle fleet administration. 
•	Knowledge of accounting software such as Xero. 
Benefits
•	Competitive salary package. 
•	Stable full-time employment. 
•	Supportive and friendly working environment. 
•	Opportunities for career growth and professional development. 
How to Apply
Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

result.description:
This role is responsible for leading all construction activities by ensuring the Project Teams are delivering projects to the highest standard and optimising resources while delivering projects on time and on budget without compromising quality or safety.

Your role will interact with and be supporting other key employees in continually developing, improving and monitoring project delivery systems, procedures and compliance protocols. With experience of effective project delivery, the Project Manager will always be a supporting and inspiring leader of best practice and professionalism for the wider project team.

This position offers the chance to be part of a friendly, supportive, tight-knit team. Your strong organisational and leadership skills, along with your ability to work autonomously will stand you in good stead. Experience and a track record of delivering projects is essential. You must have the right to live and work in Australia to be considered for this position.

KEY TASKS:

Liaising with clients to identify and define requirements, scope, and objectives

Ensuring that clients’ needs are met as projects evolve.

Ensuring project management activities, resources, equipment, and information are coordinated

Ensuring project financials are completed on time and progress claims are submitted in a timely manner

Analysing risks and opportunities

Overseeing project procurement management

Monitoring project progress and handle any issues that arise

Acting as the point of contact and communicate project status to all participants

Using tools to monitor working hours, plans and expenditures

Ensuring all appropriate legal paperwork is issued (e.p. contracts and terms of agreement)

Ensuring comprehensive project documentation, plans and reports are created and maintained

Ensuring standards and requirements are met through conducting quality assurance tests

Accurately utilising company project and financial management systems

Conducting contract reviews and train other team members where required to develop skills in this area

Acting as an advisor of Site Management processes & procedures to support the project construction

Operating as the Site Manager where required to ensure assigned projects continue according to schedule

Conducting regular applicable meetings (e.g. Project Control Group (PCG)) and ensure these are documented

Conducting and ensure a smooth handover of each project to clients

Managing post-handover defects as they are identified for the warranty period

Work Location: In person

QUALIFICATIONS:
Qualified in Diploma/Degree in Construction Management or Equivalent

EXPERIENCE:
Minimum 1-2 Years Experience as a Project Manager, working across facets of the construction industry and at least corporate fit -out projects

• Salary, 
o Lecturer (Level B) – AUD $133,065 to $156,864 per annum + 17% superannuation
o Senior Lecturer (Level C) – AUD $161,619 to $185,422 per annum + 17% superannuation
• Full-time
• 2-Year Convertible Tenure Track or continuing appointment
• Location: Kensington – Sydney, Australia

The Opportunity
The School of Computer Science and Engineering in the Faculty of Engineering at UNSW has an opportunity for a Lecturer / Senior Lecturer to join a leading teaching and research team. This role will contribute to research and teaching in modern computing systems, with a focus on databases and related areas including human-centric databases, vector databases and high-dimensional databases for scientific discovery.

You will contribute to high-quality research outcomes, collaborative research initiatives and the School’s reputation in data management and database systems. At Lecturer level, you will develop your research profile and contribute to collaborative research and scholarly publications. At Senior Lecturer level, you will bring a strong track record of research leadership, competitive funding and supervision, while also contributing to curriculum development and educational leadership.

About You
You are an emerging or established academic with expertise in database systems and a passion for both research and teaching. You will have the ability to contribute to high-quality research outcomes while delivering engaging and innovative learning experiences for undergraduate and postgraduate students.

At Lecturer level (Level B), you will be developing your research profile and contributing to collaborative research activities, including competitive grant applications and scholarly publications, while also delivering high-quality teaching and supporting student learning across undergraduate and postgraduate courses.

At Senior Lecturer level (Level C), you will demonstrate an established research track record with evidence of research leadership, success in securing competitive funding, supervising HDR students, and making significant independent contributions to your field. You will also contribute to educational leadership through high-quality teaching, curriculum development, and mentoring students and colleagues.

You are an engaging educator with experience in delivering high-quality teaching and contributing to curriculum development. You are collaborative, adaptable, and motivated to contribute to a high-performing academic environment and to build strong relationships across academia and industry.

About UNSW
UNSW is a world-leading institution recognised for its scale, prestige and impact. With strong industry engagement and partnerships across sectors, UNSW provides an environment where academic expertise translates into real-world outcomes. The university is home to cutting-edge research that drives innovation and societal progress, while its excellence in teaching ensures students are prepared to lead in their fields.The School of Computer Science and Engineering is one of the largest and most prestigious schools of computing in Australia. It offers undergraduate programmes in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science and Bioinformatics, as well as combined degrees with other disciplines. Our research and teaching staff are world leading as they advance knowledge and learning. For more information on our school, please visit: https://www.unsw.edu.au/engineering/our-schools/computer-science-and-engineering 

Skills & Experience:
Lecturer (Level B)
• A PhD in a related discipline, and/or relevant work experience
• Proven commitment to proactively keeping up to date with discipline knowledge and developments
• Demonstrated experience in teaching and learning design, development and delivery at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level
• Experience using and/or designing with educational technologies and online delivery methods
• Evidence of teaching effectiveness and passion for educational excellence (e.g. relevant discipline-based curriculum design and development at a variety of levels and scales)
• Demonstrated knowledge of industry or experience of work-integrated learning (desirable)
• Evidence of ability to support and inspire students from diverse backgrounds and support student equity, diversity & inclusion initiatives

Senior Lecturer (Level C)
• A PhD in a related discipline, and/or relevant work experience
• Proven commitment to proactively keeping up to date with discipline knowledge and developments
• Demonstrated experience in teaching and learning design using a range of pedagogical approaches, development and delivery of courses and programs, at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level
• Experience of implementing educational technologies and online delivery methods
• Evidence of teaching effectiveness and passion for educational excellence and fostering this in others
• Demonstrated success in initiating curriculum development and improvement
• Demonstrated experience with industry or work-integrated learning
• Evidence of ability to support and inspire students from diverse backgrounds and support student equity diversity and inclusion initiatives.
• Demonstrated track record in research with outcomes of high quality and high impact with clear evidence of the desire and ability to continually achieve research excellence as well as the capacity for research leadership
• Experience in successfully recruiting and supervising high calibre students
• Demonstrated ability to work in a team, collaborate across disciplines and build effective relationships
• Evidence of highly developed interpersonal and organisational skills
• Demonstrated ability to interact with the profession and industry and attract funding for learning and teaching initiatives
• An understanding of and commitment to UNSW’s aims, objectives and values in action, together with relevant policies and guidelines
• Knowledge of health and safety responsibilities and commitment to attending relevant health and safety training

To Apply: 
If you are an emerging academic looking to build your research and teaching profile, or an established academic seeking to further your career, this opportunity offers the chance to contribute to high-quality research, deliver engaging teaching, and help shape the future direction of the School. We encourage you to click “Apply Now” and submit your CV, cover letter, and responses addressing the Skills and Experience criteria.
Apply here: https://external-careers.jobs.unsw.edu.au/cw/en/job/541261/lecturersenior-lecturer-databases

If you have had any interruption in your career, you are encouraged to include a ROPE statement as part of your application. For information on ROPE please check: https://www.arc.gov.au/about-arc/program-policies/research-opportunity-and-performance-evidence-rope-statement 

Please note applications will not be accepted if sent to the contact listed below.

Contact: Eugene Aves - Talent Acquisition Consultant
E: eugene.aves@unsw.edu.au

Applications close: 11:50pm (Sydney time) on Tuesday 18 August 2026

As part of our recruitment process candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening, which may include reference checks, qualification verification, right-to-work verification, and criminal history screening where relevant to the role.

UNSW is committed to evolving a culture that embraces equity and supports a diverse and inclusive community where everyone can participate fairly, in a safe and respectful environment. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage applications from people of diverse gender, orientation, cultural & linguistic backgrounds, Aboriginal & Torres Strait Islander background, people with disability and those with caring & family responsibilities. UNSW provides workplace adjustments for people with disability, and access to flexible work options for eligible staff. The University reserves the right not to proceed with any appointment.

SQL DBA opportunity offering the change to get involved in modern cloud platform work   Your new company  
 
 Join a large-scale infrastructure modernisation program focused on transforming a complex SQL database environment 
 
   
 This role offers a blend of traditional DBA responsibilities and modern cloud platform work, making it ideal for someone who enjoys database administration while also contributing to automation, infrastructure as code, data warehousing, and cloud initiatives. You'll work across SQL Server, Azure, and enterprise data platforms, helping drive reliability, performance, and continuous improvement. 
   Your new role  
 
 Administer and support Microsoft SQL Server environments. 
 Manage performance tuning, backup and recovery, patching, security, and high availability. 
 Support and optimise data warehouse and reporting environments. 
 Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform. 
 Assist with Azure cloud administration and platform improvements. 
 Contribute to automation, monitoring, and CI/CD initiatives. 
 Troubleshoot database and platform issues across BAU and project environments. 
 Maintain technical standards, documentation, and operational procedures. 
 
   
  What you'll need to succeed  
 
 Proven experience as a SQL Server DBA. 
 Strong skills across performance tuning, maintenance, security, and disaster recovery. 
 Experience supporting enterprise-scale database environments. 
 Hands-on Azure cloud experience. 
 Experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices. 
 Exposure to data warehousing and modern data platforms. 
 PowerShell scripting and automation experience. 
 Knowledge of Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines. 
 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 
   
   What you'll get in return     In return, you will receive a great daily rate, alongside the opportunity to work within a highly regarded mining organisation getting involved in exciting work across a cutting-edge cloud environment.
